headline: European Gas Prices Drop 2% as Markets Monitor Middle East and U.S. Politics
summary: European benchmark natural gas prices at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility fell by 2% as traders await developments in Iran following the U.S. midterm elections.
why: The Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF) is the primary pricing benchmark for the European natural gas market, making its fluctuations critical for regional energy costs and utility providers.

impacts.why: European benchmark natural gas prices fell by 2% at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility.
